text:
Jordan (PM): quick sync — we need to lock final GA criteria for Dedicated: SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing. can we get consensus by EOD?
Alex G: +1. propose baseline SLA 99.95% monthly for reserved pools. include rollback policy for perf regressions.
Sam - SRE: 99.95% sounds reasonable. must have playbooks for: GPU OOM, scheduler deadlock, KV cache corruption. I'll own runbooks.
Maria L: I'll draft GA docs: quickstart, SLA explainer, config examples, migration & rollback guide, troubleshooting. ETA 48h.
Nina - Support: Support readiness: tiered response times and escalation. propose: enterprise ack <1h, P1 <30m, P2 <4h. need enablement deck + runbook links for triage.
Priya - Pricing: Pricing structure: reserved capacity SKU (monthly), committed units, overage rates, burst pricing. need final per-GPU unit cost + public pricing page copy.
Jordan (PM): monitoring + SLOs are critical — need dashboards, synthetic e2e checks, error-budget alerts, and tracing hooks for model fallbacks.
Sam - SRE: adding a quick alert example for Prometheus/Alertmanager: ```
alert: SchedulerLatencyHigh
expr: job:scheduler_request_latency:p95 > 0.5
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Scheduler p95 > 500ms"
```
Alex G: rollout plan suggestion: canary -> 5% tenants for 24h -> 20% for 48h -> full. auto rollback triggers: latency p95 +5% over baseline OR error-rate increase >2x OR synthetic test failures.
Nina - Support: Do we have beta customers lined up? We should run a readiness drill and shadow on-call next Wed.
Jordan (PM): decision proposals to lock: SLA=99.95%, support ack times as above, docs + runbooks live before GA, pricing page public, monitoring with synthetic tests and error-budget alerts, 3-stage canary with automatic rollback. owners assigned.
Maria L: will post doc links as they land and ping #product.
OncallBot: reminder — runbook drill scheduled Wed 09:00 UTC.
Alex G: I'll prepare the canary automation and the rollback playbook. Sam will wire alerts and dashboards. Priya will finalize pricing copy. Nina will schedule the support enablement session. Jordan: I'll compile a single GA checklist and sign-off doc.
